title: U-Net Mars O2+ Beams: inference code and trained model
description: U-Net v12 count2 inference code and trained weights for MAVEN STATIC O2+ spectra. Inputs use strict two-count-equivalent validity. Default inference uses 512 x 32 windows and stride 51; source training stride is 256. Includes a synthetic example and model documentation. Source code is MIT licensed and trained weights are CC BY 4.0 licensed.
